    else
      B_nonX <= B;

    if ((B_nonX == 'b1) || (B_nonX == 'b0))

    else
      B_inv <= #0 'bz;

      A_r <= 1'bz;              
      B_r <= 1'bz;              
      line_en <= 1'b0;     
    end else begin              
      if (line_en) begin        
        B_r <= 1'bz;            
        if ((ERR_INSERT == "ON") & (phy_init_done))

        else
          A_r <= #Delay_rd B_nonX; 
      end else begin            
        B_r <= #Delay_g A;      
        A_r <= 1'bz;            
      end
    end

      line_en <= 1'b0;          
    end else if (A !== A_r) begin 
      line_en <= 1'b0;          
    end else if (B_r !== B) begin 
      line_en <= 1'b1;          
    end else begin
